name: hud_ui_remove_scoreboard_entry_row
description: HudUi::RemoveScoreboardEntryRow forwards a player row to the active stats-list triplet for scoreboard removal.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent HUD triplet/list-menu source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4143c0 validates forwarding the GameNetPlayerRow argument through g_HudUiMgrStatsList->triplet to HudUiTriplet::RemoveEntry.
The native triplet scoreboard smoke verifies the wrapper-driven remove path deletes the selected row and rebuilds the rendered scoreboard state.
